key_terms.مَكْرُوهٌ: Disliked (a category of legal ruling in Shia fiqh, between halal and haram)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on eating too much?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on foods, this concise narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes excessive eating as *makruh*, linking physical moderation to spiritual purity. In Shia jurisprudence, this principle is often extended to argue that gluttony can distract the heart from divine remembrance, thereby serving as a foundational ethical guideline for maintaining balance in worldly sustenance.
